title: The Return of the Nirvana Fallacy: A Review of John Cassidy’s Capitalism and Its Critics
title_zh: 涅槃谬论的回归：评约翰·卡西迪的《资本主义及其批评者》
authors: Costa, Dora L., Kahn, Matthew E.
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: John Cassidy's Capitalism and Its Critics surveys 250 years of capitalism's history through the eyes of roughly thirty critics, from the Luddites, early utopians and Marx to modern communitarians, antigrowth proponents, free trade opponents, and scholars of inequality. The result is a vivid, sympathetic reconstruction of left-of-center dissent. We argue, however, that the book reproduces two analytical weaknesses shared by the critics it profiles. First, it commits Harold Demsetz's Nirvana Fallacy, evaluating imperfect real-world markets against idealized regulatory alternatives rather than against equally imperfect real-world governments. Second, it underestimates capitalism's most distinctive self-correcting mechanisms: endogenous technological change and entrepreneurial creative destruction, all coordinated by the price system. The result is a catalogue of capitalism's failures unaccompanied by any comparable accounting of the alternatives.
abstract_zh: 约翰·卡西迪的《资本主义及其批评者》通过约三十位批评者的视角——从卢德分子、早期乌托邦主义者、马克思，到现代社群主义者、反增长倡导者、自由贸易反对者及不平等问题学者——审视了资本主义250年的历史。其结果是对中左翼异议的生动而富有同情心的重构。然而，我们认为该书重现了其所述批评者共有的两个分析缺陷。其一，它陷入了哈罗德·德姆塞茨的"涅槃谬误"，将不完美的现实市场与理想化的监管替代方案进行比较，而非与同样不完美的现实政府进行对比。其二，它低估了资本主义最独特的自我修正机制：由价格体系协调的内生技术变革与企业家创造性破坏。最终呈现的是一份资本主义失败的清单，却未对替代方案进行任何同等程度的评估。

title: The Returns to Government R&D: Evidence from US Appropriations Shocks
title_zh: 政府研发投入的回报：来自美国拨款冲击的证据
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Based on a narrative classification of all significant postwar changes in R&D appropriations for five major federal agencies, we find that an increase in nondefense R&D appropriations leads to increases in various measures of innovative activity and higher business-sector productivity in the long run. We structurally estimate the production function elasticity of nondefense government R&D capital using the SP-IV methodology of Lewis and Mertens (2024) and obtain implied returns of 140 to 210 percent over the postwar period. The estimates indicate that government-funded R&D accounts for one-fifth of business-sector TFP growth since WWII, and imply substantial underfunding of nondefense R&D.
abstract_zh: 基于对五大联邦机构战后研发拨款重大变动的叙事分类，我们发现非国防研发拨款的增加长期内会提升各类创新活动指标及商业部门生产率。我们采用Lewis与Mertens（2024）提出的SP-IV方法，对非国防政府研发资本的生产函数弹性进行结构估计，得出战后时期隐含回报率为140%至210%。估算结果表明，二战以来政府资助的研发贡献了商业部门全要素生产率增长的五分之一，并暗示非国防研发存在显著的资金不足问题。

title: Putting Things in Order: Patterns of Trade Dynamics and Macroeconomics
title_zh: 有序安排：贸易动态与宏观经济的模式
authors: Robert Feenstra, Andrew Rose, Volker Nocke, Andrew Rhodes, Dirk Bergemann 等
official: 官方在线 1997-05-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a procedure to rank-order countries and commodities using disaggregated US imports data. It finds strong evidence that both countries and commodities can be ranked, consistent with the ?product cycle? hypothesis. Countries habitually begin to export goods to the United States according to an ordering; goods are also exported in order. We estimate these orderings using a semi-parametric methodology that takes account of the fact that most goods are not exported by most countries in the sample. The orderings seem sensible, robust and intuitive. For instance, the country rankings derived from disaggregated trade data turn out to be highly correlated with macroeconomic phenomena such as national productivity levels and growth rates.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国进口细分数据，开发了一套对国家与商品进行排序的方法。研究发现，国家与商品均可被排序，这一结果与"产品周期"假说高度吻合。各国通常按照特定顺序开始向美国出口商品，而商品本身也遵循特定出口次序。我们采用半参数方法估算这些排序，该方法充分考虑了样本中多数国家未出口多数商品这一事实。所得排序结果合理、稳健且符合直觉。例如，基于细分贸易数据得出的国家排名，与国民生产率水平及增长率等宏观经济现象呈现高度相关性。

title: Artisanal and Small-Scale Mines in Africa: Where, When and Why
title_zh: 非洲手工与小规模采矿：地点、时间与原因
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has emerged as a key but poorly understood source of supply. We construct the first continental-scale panel of mining activity in Sub-Saharan Africa by applying supervised deep-learning methods to satellite imagery, identifying over 50,000 mining sites across 39 countries and reconstructing monthly activity from 2000 to 2019. We document three main findings. First, mining location follows strong market-access gradients with pronounced non-linearities: proximity to ports raises mining probability within 200 km, but this premium reverses at intermediate distances and re-emerges only in the most remote areas -- consistent with distance from urban centers proxying for weaker state reach and lower monitoring of informal activity. Second, entry responds rapidly to commodity price shocks, indicating that ASM operates as an elastic margin of mineral supply; over time, however, its relationship with industrial mining shifts from complementarity to a reallocation of artisanal activity away from industrial sites. Third, agricultural shocks induce entry into ASM, but spatial labor mobility attenuates local responses, pointing to strong congestion effects. Together, these results position ASM as a central yet spatially constrained adjustment margin in global critical mineral supply.
abstract_zh: 随着能源转型加速对关键矿产的需求，手工和小规模采矿（ASM）已成为重要但认知不足的供应来源。我们通过将监督式深度学习方法应用于卫星图像，构建了首个撒哈拉以南非洲大陆尺度的采矿活动面板数据，识别出39个国家的5万多个采矿点，并重建了2000年至2019年的月度活动数据。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，采矿选址遵循显著的非线性市场可达性梯度——靠近港口在200公里范围内提高采矿概率，但这一优势在中等距离处逆转，仅在偏远地区重新显现，这与远离城市中心反映国家管控薄弱、非正规活动监管较少的情况一致。第二，采矿进入对大宗商品价格冲击反应迅速，表明ASM作为矿产供应的弹性边际发挥作用；但随时间推移，其与工业采矿的关系从互补转向手工活动从工业场地的重新配置。第三，农业冲击促使劳动力进入ASM，但空间劳动力流动削弱了局部响应，表明存在显著的拥挤效应。综合来看，这些结论将ASM定位为全球关键矿产供应中核心但受空间约束的调整边际。

title: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty
title_zh: 检索失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的实地实验
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such "retrieval failures" distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories---without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase "remembered" expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season---the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply---with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year's crop revenue. We replicate the intervention's impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
abstract_zh: 个体在决策时可能无法回忆并使用已知信息。我们通过实证研究考察这种"检索失败"是否扭曲了赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为——这些农民的收入来源于每年一次收获，随后在全年逐步消耗。研究发现，个体对未来支出的低估幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善信息回忆，我们随机实施了一项干预措施：引导个体通过类别联想的方式梳理未来支出（不提供任何外部信息或指导）。受干预群体"被回忆起的"支出增加了36-60%；正如记忆文献所预测，该效应集中于小额、非规律性及随机性支出项目。即时消费有所下降，干预六周后，受干预家庭的储蓄水平高出15%。随后他们进入饥饿季（通常消费急剧下降的年末月份）时，额外拥有一个月的储蓄，使得全年消费曲线更为平缓。家庭将增加的储蓄用于农业投资自融资，使次年作物收入提升9%。我们还在美国低收入群体中复制了该干预对信念的影响，表明检索失败现象具有跨情境和跨人群的普遍性。

title: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
title_zh: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计问题，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者进行互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台针对不同类型的企业设计了一套定制化合同菜单，并将消费者访问量分配给这些企业。研究表明，最优平台设计会产生“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业获得不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且与无设计基准相比，该设计能够改善消费者福利。

title: Alternative Agricultural Carbon Border Adjustment and Climate Club Designs : a Quantitative Assessment
title_zh: 替代性农业碳边境调节与气候俱乐部设计：一项量化评估
authors: Lærke Jensbye, Wusheng Yu, Francesco Clora
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze alternative agricultural carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) designs across three dimensions (participating countries, emission intensity, and carbon price). We find that an agricultural CBAM by the European Union (or an expanded climate club consisting of the EU and other countries) has minor global agricultural GHG emission implications but protects the most emission intensive domestic production. Nevertheless, having a larger climate club imposing CBAM tariffs and applying exporters’ emission intensities are more effective in lowering global emissions. Compared to national carbon prices, harmonized carbon prices at climate club level can reduce trade disruptions while attaining similar emission reduction outcomes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们从三个维度（参与国、排放强度与碳价格）分析了农业碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的不同设计方案。研究发现，欧盟（或由欧盟及其他国家组成的扩大化气候俱乐部）实施的农业CBAM对全球农业温室气体排放影响较小，但能保护国内排放强度最高的生产活动。然而，由更大规模的气候俱乐部征收CBAM关税并采用出口国排放强度的方案，在降低全球排放方面更为有效。相较于各国自主设定的碳价格，在气候俱乐部层面实施统一的碳价格可在实现相近减排效果的同时减少贸易扭曲。

title: Central Clearing for Government Securities Repos: A CCP-Centric Perspective
title_zh: 政府证券回购的中央清算：以中央对手方为中心的视角
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Government securities-backed repo markets constitute a key funding source for market participants in many jurisdictions. A number of recent stress episodes, e.g., in US and UK repo markets, has led to renewed efforts to strengthen the resilience of repo markets. This notably includes a push to increased central clearing via central counterparties (CCPs) which may come via market incentives or in the form of mandatory clearing. Central clearing is commonly considered as a key tool to increase transparency and understanding of markets and improve the risk management practices of market participants. This paper provides a brief overview of post trade-arrangements in select government securities repo markets and offers a structured analysis of potential benefits and risks of bringing repo markets onto centrally cleared platforms from a CCP perspective. The paper lists a set of key considerations that CCPs—and indirectly—policy makers could take into account when exploring the expansion of repo clearing services or opting for a repo clearing mandate. Aside from considerations pertaining to access modalities to repo clearing services, default management and market structure-related aspects are of key importance. Together, these factors ensure that the transition of repo transactions from a decentralized, uncleared set-up to central clearing is conducive to more resilient repo and ultimately government bond markets.
abstract_zh: 政府证券回购市场是许多司法管辖区市场参与者的关键融资来源。近期美国及英国回购市场等多起压力事件，促使各方重新致力于增强回购市场的韧性。这尤其体现在通过中央对手方（CCPs）推动中央清算的强化举措——可能通过市场激励或强制清算形式实现。中央清算通常被视为提升市场透明度与认知度、改善市场参与者风险管理实践的关键工具。本文简要概述了特定政府证券回购市场的交易后安排，并从中央对手方视角系统分析了将回购市场纳入中央清算平台带来的潜在收益与风险。文章列出了一系列关键考量因素，供中央对手方（及间接的政策制定者）在探索扩大回购清算服务或选择回购清算强制令时参考。除涉及回购清算服务准入模式外，违约管理与市场结构相关要素同样至关重要。这些因素共同确保回购交易从分散化、非清算模式向中央清算的转型，有助于构建更具韧性的回购市场，并最终强化政府债券市场。

title: Alternative Scenarios at the Federal Reserve from 1968 to 2020: Data, Interpretation, and Evaluation
title_zh: 1968年至2020年美联储的替代情景：数据、解释与评估
authors: Edward P. Herbst, Scott R. Konzem, Cristina Scofield
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We comprehensively document 1, 265 Federal Reserve staff alternative scenarios presented to the Federal Open Market Committee in publicly released materials from 1968 to 2020. Scenarios grew in frequency and sophistication, typically spanning a range of outcomes around the baseline. We construct a taxonomy with six categories: aggregate demand, aggregate supply, external risks, financial conditions, fiscal policy, and expectation shifts. Staff qualitative risk assessments complemented the scenario composition. Comparing scenario forecasts to realized outcomes, the most accurate scenarios often anticipated major macroeconomic developments even when magnitudes were missed, revealing the value and limits of scenario analysis for central bank risk management.
abstract_zh: 我们系统梳理了1968年至2020年间美联储工作人员在公开材料中向联邦公开市场委员会提交的1265份替代情景分析。这些情景分析的频率和复杂程度持续提升，通常围绕基准预测构建一系列可能结果。我们构建了包含六大类别的分类体系：总需求、总供给、外部风险、金融状况、财政政策及预期变化。工作人员的风险定性评估与情景构成形成互补。通过将情景预测与实际结果对比发现，即便在数值预测存在偏差时，最精准的情景往往仍能预判重大宏观经济走势，这揭示了情景分析在央行风险管理中的价值与局限性。

title: Economic inequality and social mobility in preindustrial societies: What we know, what we don't (but should) know
title_zh: 前工业化社会的经济不平等与社会流动性：已知、未知与应知
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In recent years economic inequality has become a major research topic in economic history. However, much remains to be done to complete our knowledge of long‐term distributive dynamics. This article highlights several promising avenues for future research, focusing on the preindustrial period. In particular, it identifies the main gaps that still need to be filled in reconstructions of wealth and income distributions; it argues for a closer interaction between scholars working on economic inequality and those working on historical gross domestic product (GDP); and it highlights socio‐economic mobility as a closely related, but much less explored, research area. Shifting the focus from inequality to mobility, and more generally considering how human agency helped shape the aggregate long‐term dynamics we observe, requires examining individual actors and their specific motivations more closely. This is especially true for the socio‐economic elites who, when faced with a perceived threat of status loss, could attempt to capture political institutions, thus securing their control over valuable public resources, whilst at the same time acting as ‘enemies of mobility’. The article also highlights how this kind of research speaks directly to current societal concerns.
abstract_zh: 近年来，经济不平等已成为经济史领域的重要研究课题。然而，关于长期分配动态的认知仍存在大量空白。本文聚焦前工业化时期，为未来研究指明了若干富有前景的方向。具体而言，本文识别了财富与收入分布重建中仍需填补的主要空白；主张研究经济不平等与历史国内生产总值（GDP）的学者应加强互动；并强调社会经济流动性是一个密切相关但研究尚不充分的领域。将研究重心从不平等转向流动性，并更广泛地思考人类能动性如何塑造我们所观察到的长期宏观动态，需要更深入地审视个体行为者及其特定动机。这一点对社会经济精英尤为关键——当面临地位丧失的威胁时，他们可能试图捕获政治制度以维持对公共资源的控制，同时充当"流动性的敌人"。本文还揭示了此类研究如何直接回应当前的社会关切。

title: A Dynamic Model of the Racial Wealth Gap
title_zh: 种族财富差距的动态模型
authors: Sylvain Catherine, Ellen Jiayang Lu, James D Paron
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: What explains wealth and portfolio differences between black and white Americans? We find that disparities in economic factors explain portfolios well, but only partly explain the wealth gap. In a dynamic setting, economic factors often change optimal saving rates in ways that offset their effects on income and returns. Consequently, their net wealth effect is often limited, making the wealth gap harder to explain. We estimate that differences in income levels, income risk, family structures, mortality, health expenditures, property taxes, mortgage rates, and asset returns explain half of the differential between the racial wealth gap and the racial income gap.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了美国黑人与白人之间的财富和投资组合差异？我们发现，经济因素的差异能够较好地解释投资组合差异，但只能部分解释财富差距。在动态环境中，经济因素常常会改变最优储蓄率，从而抵消其对收入和回报的影响。因此，这些因素的净财富效应往往有限，使得财富差距更难以解释。我们估算，收入水平、收入风险、家庭结构、死亡率、医疗支出、房产税、抵押贷款利率以及资产回报率的差异，解释了种族财富差距与种族收入差距之间差异的一半。

title: Universal Investments in Toddler Health. Learning from a Large Government Trial
title_zh: 幼儿健康的普遍投资：来自一项大型政府试验的启示
authors: Jennifer L Baker, Lise G Bjerregaard, Christian M Dahl, Torben S D Johansen, Emil N Sørensen 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Exploiting a 1960s government trial in Copenhagen, we study the long-run effects of preventive health care for toddlers. We combine administrative data with handwritten nurse records to document universal treatment take-up. Treated children enjoy a five percent of a standard deviation increase in a good adult health index. While initial trial cohorts experience positive health and labour market impacts, those are absent for the final cohorts. Impacts are largest for children with initial health disadvantage and females, and we identify childhood health improvements as a core mechanism. The heterogeneity of trial effects across individuals’ initial health status and cohorts documents that universal toddler care can alleviate health inequalities at low costs, and that the counterfactual policy environment matters.
abstract_zh: 利用20世纪60年代在哥本哈根开展的一项政府试验，我们研究了幼儿预防性医疗保健的长期影响。我们将行政数据与手写护士记录相结合，记录了普遍的治疗接受情况。接受治疗的儿童在成年健康综合指数上提高了0.05个标准差。尽管最初的试验队列在健康和劳动力市场方面产生了积极影响，但最终队列并未观察到这些影响。对于初始健康状况较差的儿童和女性，影响最为显著，并且我们确定儿童期健康状况改善是核心机制。试验效果因个体初始健康状况和队列而异，这表明普遍的幼儿保健能够以低成本缓解健康不平等，且反事实政策环境至关重要。

title: Identification-robust inference for the LATE with high-dimensional covariates
title_zh: 高维协变量下局部平均处理效应的识别稳健推断
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2023-02-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper presents an inference method for the local average treatment effect (LATE) in the presence of high-dimensional covariates, regardless of the strength of identification. We propose an orthogonalized Anderson-Rubin test statistic that maintains uniformly valid asymptotic size. We provide an easy-to-implement algorithm for inferring the high-dimensional LATE by inverting our test statistic and employing the double/debiased machine learning method. Simulation results show that our test achieves better size control under both weak identification and high dimensionality, outperforming conventional alternatives. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe wider confidence intervals than those obtained using conventional methods.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维协变量存在下，无论识别强度如何，对局部平均处理效应（LATE）进行推断的方法。我们构建了一个正交化的安德森-鲁宾检验统计量，该统计量能保持均匀有效的渐近规模。通过反转该检验统计量并采用双重/去偏机器学习方法，我们提供了一种易于实现的算法来推断高维LATE。模拟结果表明，在弱识别和高维性条件下，我们的检验在规模控制方面优于传统替代方法。将所提方法应用于铁路与人口数据以研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响时，我们观察到比传统方法更宽的置信区间。
